en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a circular fountain and small pool in the foreground, lined with leafless trees and bordered by grand late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left stands an ornate domed building, while on the right a tall Baroque church tower with an onion‑shaped spire rises above attached structures. The street running through the square contains early motor vehicles and pedestrians. Shopfronts with awnings face the square. No visible caption text is present on the front.
